$comment: The pinned toolchain. scripts/bootstrap.ps1 reads this file; it is the only
place a version or a URL is written. D00 T01 §1 owns the format, D00 T01 §6
Every sha256 was taken from a real download on 2026-09-17 and independently
cross-checked against the digest GitHub records for the same asset. A pin
without a hash is reproducible only until a release is re-cut in place.
The python and sccache pins followed the same rule on 2026-11-09: sccache
against the .sha256 Mozilla publishes, python against the python.org file.

components.name: llvm-mingw
components.note: Self-contained UCRT-targeting archive. Carries its own headers and import libraries, so no Windows SDK is needed and no licence question arises. Targets the MinGW-w64 environment, not the MSVC ABI.

components.name: python
components.note: The official embeddable distribution: a full CPython with its standard library and no pip. That is exactly the shape the repository's tooling needs, because every scripts/*.py file is stdlib-only (verified 2026-11-09: the only non-stdlib import is the repository's own scripts/lib). No pip means no per-machine package state to drift.

components.name: sccache
components.note: Compile cache, wired in by scripts/build.ps1 as the CMake compiler launcher with its cache under build/sccache capped at 10 GB. The sha256 above was cross-checked against the .sha256 asset Mozilla publishes beside the zip, the same standard the 2026-09-17 pins were held to.
